verdict.rationale: Nix has a documented, scriptable official CLI (nix build, develop, run, search, flake) that an agent can drive non-interactively, e.g. `nix-shell --run "<command>"`. However, the evidence shows no documented programmatic API beyond the CLI, and probes for OpenAPI specs returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented programmatic API (library bindings, daemon protocol or HTTP interface), a machine-readable API spec, and independent evidence of agents driving Nix programmatically.
